description: This source file defines configurations, validation functions, and UI logic for setting remote controller IP address and port in a Fyne-based GUI application. It includes C interop via cgo for setting remote address externally.

methods.name: portValidator
methods.description: Validates if the provided port string is a numeric value within the acceptable range for network ports (49152-65535).

methods.name: ipValidator
methods.description: Validates if the provided IP string has the correct IPv4 format with each octet between 0 and 255.
